messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: billing.shadow-ledger mismatch — ratecard shadow counts diverging vs primary. Overflagging started ~08:42 UTC. https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/ABCD1234 :rotating_light:
alice.m: seeing alerts for ~120 accounts with overage flags, most in EU
raj: checking emitter logs, looks like consumer lag on shard eu-west-1 (kinesis consumer #3). Token counts held back then emitted in burst.
lina: can we silence customer alerts while we investigate? suggest flip billing.aggregator -> primary-aggregator for 1h. @ops-oncall
ops-oncall: running rollback:
```bash
curl -XPOST https://ops-api/reconfig -d '{"key":"billing.aggregator","value":"primary"}'
```
ops-oncall: command succeeded, switching traffic to primary aggregator, warm caches.
billing-service: pausing automated overage emails via config flag: `notifications.overage.enabled=false` (doing now)
alice.m: confirmed overage email queue drained, no new emails for last 2m :white_check_mark: 
raj: digging traces, root cause looks like delayed ACKs causing dedupe window to expire, leading to double-count on replay. patch idea: extend dedupe window + add sequence id.
lina: good call. can we enable sequence-id dedupe as emergency patch?
ops-oncall: applied temporary dedupe-extension=30m, and enabled seq-id check for eu-west-1. Observability: counters aligning now.
billing-service: rerunning reconciliation job for last 6h to scrub false charges, will post ETA.
simon: please open a postmortem ticket and notify customer-ops for manual credits if needed. also limit alerts to P1 only.
alice.m: thanks team. will follow up with customer impact summary and credit estimate. closing pager once reconciliation completes.
incident-bot: Pager cleared at 08:49 UTC — mitigation in place, follow-up ticket: #INC-4827
